name: Replication fork DNA synthesis with error-prone translesion bypass
rationale: All members are PCNA-coupled polymerase activities at the replication fork (priming, elongation, polymerase switching, flap removal, damage recognition and TLS); the error-prone TLS polymerases separate it from the BER/telomere and error-free TLS/NER confusables.

core: Notch receptor signaling to the nucleus
name: NOTCH1-4 signal transduction and target gene transcription
rationale: Members cover activation, nuclear signaling and transcriptional output of NOTCH1, 2, 3 and 4 plus HLH target induction; the NOTCH3/4 and target-transcription members distinguish it from NOTCH1-PEST/FBXW7 and NOTCH2/Th2-focused confusables.

name: Hematopoietic differentiation toward primitive and definitive erythrocytes
rationale: Members concern hemopoiesis and stem cell differentiation control steering to primitive and definitive erythrocytes, unlike confusables centred on heme/late erythroid biology or HSC homeostasis and proliferation.

qualifier: with vitamin E metabolism and spastic paraplegia defects
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis, vitamin E metabolism, spastic paraplegias
rationale: Members are cholesterol catabolism to bile acids via hydroxycholesterols and its CYP defects (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42) plus vitamin E metabolism and transport, the latter and the paraplegias absent from the bile acid transport, peroxisomal oxidation and cholesterol synthesis confusables.

name: Positive regulation of postsynaptic structural plasticity and maturation
rationale: All members promote postsynaptic structure (spines, PSD, actin, receptor delivery, local translation, maturation, plasticity), whereas confusables emphasise LTP/LTD calcium control, negative spine regulation or dendrite arborization.

name: Amyloid-beta formation, clearance and glial activation regulation
rationale: Members centre on APP processing, amyloid fibril/tangle formation and amyloid-beta clearance together with microglial/astrocyte activation and glial survival, while confusables are microglial differentiation, cytotoxicity and lipoprotein responses without amyloid handling.

name: Mullerian duct-derived tract and genitalia development
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of oviduct, uterus, vagina and genitalia, distinguishing it from gonad/testis determination, nephric duct/ureteric bud and prostate gland confusables.

name: Cadherin adhesion remodelling in EMT and delamination
rationale: Members regulate cadherin adhesion and adherens junctions in the context of TGF-beta EMT, delamination and Rho-GTPase-limited invasion, whereas confusables cover apical junction assembly, polarity and CDH gene transcription.

name: Mitochondrial quality control via PINK1-Parkin mitophagy and fission-fusion
rationale: Members link depolarisation-triggered PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion, protein retention at mitochondria and membrane potential, unlike confusables on receptor-mediated mitophagy, mitochondrial import or aggrephagy/pexophagy.

name: FRS2/SHC-mediated MAPK signaling by FGFR1 and FGFR4
rationale: Members are FRS- and SHC-driven MAPK cascades from FGFR1 and FGFR4 (with beta-Klotho ligand binding), distinct from PI3K/PLC branches and FGFR2/FGFR3 confusables.

qualifier: IL-3/5/7/9 and FLT3 with CBL attenuation
name: Hematopoietic cytokine (IL-3/5/7/9, FLT3) signaling with CBL attenuation
rationale: Members are STAT5/SHC signaling from IL-3, IL-5, IL-7, IL-9, G-CSF and FLT3 receptors and their CBL/negative regulation, separating it from IL-2-centred, EPO/TPO and fusion-oncoprotein confusables.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mitoribosome-associated quality control
rationale: Members are mitochondrial transcription initiation, termination and regulation plus mitoribosome quality control, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial translation, RNA processing/modification and mtDNA replication.

qualifier: ligand-withdrawal signaling and FOXO death transcription
name: Neuronal stress and ligand-withdrawal apoptosis with FOXO death transcription
rationale: Members regulate neuron death decisions (oxidative stress, ligand-absence signaling, CDK5, UPRmt, PI3K-FOXO death genes); FOXO death genes and UPRmt separate it from dependence-receptor confusables and ligand-absence/neuronal members from AKT-FOXO and HSF1 confusables.

qualifier: tRNA modification, aminoacylation and translation-factor hypermodification
name: Translational fidelity via tRNA modification, aminoacylation and factor hypermodification
rationale: Members are tRNA maturation, anticodon modification and charging plus hypusine/diphthamide/hydroxylation of translation machinery and termination/readthrough control, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial gene expression and rRNA/tRNA methylation.

qualifier: IL-5-driven, with negative Th2 cytokine regulation
name: IL-5-driven eosinophil development with negative Th2 cytokine regulation
rationale: Members cover IL-5 signaling, eosinophil (and mast cell) differentiation, migration and activation plus restraint of Th2/IL-4/IL-5 production, whereas confusables are Th2 induction, IL-4/13/33 signaling and IgE switching.

name: Non-histone protein methylation and methionine-responsive translation initiation
rationale: Members are protein mono/di/trimethylation (including p53) plus methionine sensing, cap-dependent initiation and ribosome biogenesis control, distinct from chromatin remodelling, histone-modifying, hypusine/hydroxylation and rRNA transcription confusables.

name: Forebrain neuron specification and tangential interneuron migration
rationale: Members concern cortical/thalamic regionalization, neuron-type commitment, pyramidal neuron development and tangential migration of cortical and olfactory bulb interneurons, unlike cerebellar, retinal and hindbrain confusables.

qualifier: secretion and biosynthetic control of glucocorticoids and aldosterone
name: Glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid secretion, synthesis control and response
rationale: Members regulate secretion and synthesis of cortisol, corticosterone and aldosterone (including ACTH drive) and responses to glucocorticoids, unlike the steroidogenic enzyme, stress-behaviour and thyroid confusables.

core: IL-1 family cytokine processing and signaling
name: IL-1 family cytokine processing and signaling with IL-17/Th17 axis
rationale: Members are IL-1/IL-18/IL-36/IL-38 processing and signaling plus IL-17 production, Th17 commitment and IL-17 signaling, separating it from C-type lectin, inflammasome/pyroptosis and IL-10/12/23/27 confusables.

name: IL-6-family cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members are IL-6, IL-11, CNTF, LIF and OSM receptor signaling with STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation and its negative regulation, distinct from IL-10/27/35, IL-2/common-gamma and IFNG confusables.

qualifier: proteasomal and endosomal class I and II routes
name: Proteasomal and endosomal MHC class I/II antigen processing and presentation
rationale: Members span proteasome-dependent class I loading, cross-presentation, class II presentation, APC surface signatures and viral Nef/Vpu downregulation, while confusables focus on NKT regulation, PD-L1 turnover or NK/T cytotoxicity.

name: snRNA biogenesis and histone mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members are Pol II/III snRNA transcription, cap hypermethylation, transport and snRNP assembly together with SLBP stem-loop histone pre-mRNA processing and decay, distinct from splicing-catalysis, polyadenylation and nuclear RNA decay confusables.

name: Lysosomal ganglioside catabolism and its storage disorders
rationale: Members are lysosomal glycosphingolipid/ganglioside degradation and HEXA, HEXB and NEU1 deficiencies, unlike glycosaminoglycan/mucopolysaccharidosis and sialic acid/amino-sugar metabolism confusables.

core: Cardiac contractility and heart rate regulation
name: Cardiac rate and contractility regulation via sequestered calcium release
rationale: Members regulate heart rate, contractile force, relaxation and cardiomyocyte membrane potential through calcium release and ion homeostasis, whereas confusables cover SR calcium uptake/ATPase activity, fibre-type switching or skeletal muscle ryanodine receptor control.

qualifier: epithelialization from renal vesicle to tubule
name: Metanephric nephron epithelialization and tubule morphogenesis
rationale: Members follow mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition through renal vesicle, comma- and S-shaped bodies to tubule formation, distinct from mesenchyme maintenance, ureteric bud elongation and segment patterning confusables.
